moat_against: Microsoft Teams / Google Meet bundled into suites at effectively zero incremental price
Enterprise net dollar expansion 99% — installed base not expanding spend
Online segment flat with ~2.9% monthly churn — low switching costs
AI features bundled free by rivals; monetization unproven, currently a retention cost
moat_for: Default brand and large enterprise installed base; meetings embedded in daily workflows
Platform breadth beyond meetings — Zoom Phone 10M+ paid seats, Contact Center high-double-digit growth, Workvivo — raises switching costs
~79% non-GAAP gross margin and debt-free, cash-rich balance sheet fund R&D and buybacks
moat_justification: Default-brand enterprise installed base and a broadening platform (Phone 10M+ paid seats, Contact Center, Workvivo) give real enterprise retention, but the core meeting product faces Microsoft Teams bundled at near-zero marginal price, enterprise net dollar expansion is 99%, the Online segment is flat with ~2.9% monthly churn, and AI features are bundled free by rivals — moderate moat, no proven platform-level pricing power yet.
name: Zoom Communications, Inc.
one_liner: Debt-free cash machine, moat 5/10 — TTM owner's earnings $3.99/sh growing mid-single-digits, but at $95.21 the weighted IRR is only 7.7% (IV@15% $38.30); clears 15% only below ~$38.
